Testimonials.title: Systems We Have Built

cases.title: Retail Audit System
cases.problem: Visit logs and audit proofs were scattered across WhatsApp and Excel, making consolidation difficult.
cases.solution: Centralized dashboard for logging visits, photo documentation, resolution status, and automated reporting.
cases.result: Audit progress is easily monitored in real-time by management, and monthly report creation is instant.

cases.title: Booking & Schedule Management
cases.problem: Manual WhatsApp booking led to double-bookings and consumed significant administrative hours.
cases.solution: Self-service client booking portal with real-time calendar sync and automated WhatsApp reminders.
cases.result: Reduced manual administrative load by 85% and eliminated scheduling conflicts entirely.

cases.title: B2B Customer Portal & Order Management
cases.problem: Distributor orders used manual paper/PDF forms, prone to input errors and slow stock tracking.
cases.solution: Dedicated distributor portal for order submission, real-time stock checks, auto-invoicing, and shipment tracking.
cases.result: Accelerated order cycles by 70%, improved shipping accuracy, and streamlined cash flow.

FAQ.title: Questions Before Starting the Project
FAQ.subtitle: Short answers about consultation, pricing, process, ownership, and support.
FAQ.q1: Do I need to have a feature list ready?
FAQ.a1: Not at all. We start with a consultation to understand your business challenge. Our team will help map and compile the most relevant feature list.
FAQ.q2: How does Crediblemark determine a solution?
FAQ.a2: We analyze your workflow, user profiles, and business goals. From there, we determine if the solution is a website, custom application, API integration, or automation.
FAQ.q3: How much does it cost to build a website or app?
FAQ.a3: Cost depends on complexity. We provide a transparent investment estimate after mapping out the initial blueprint, with no hidden fees at the end.
FAQ.q4: How long does the development process take?
FAQ.a4: For a ready-to-use initial version (MVP), it typically takes 4 to 8 weeks depending on the agreed feature complexity.
FAQ.q5: Who owns the source code and database?
FAQ.a5: You have 100% system ownership. Once final payment is completed, all source code, database access, and system credentials are handed over to you.
FAQ.a6: As consultants, we are flexible. Minor changes can be adjusted instantly. For major changes, we will re-prioritize features or plan a next phase to keep the release on schedule.
FAQ.q7: Is there a warranty after the system is launched?
FAQ.a7: Yes, we provide a 90-Day Bug Warranty post-launch to ensure your team's operational stability.
FAQ.a8: Absolutely. We offer regular maintenance packages to monitor server health, backup databases, and perform routine security updates.
FAQ.ctaTitle: Don't Know What System You Need?
FAQ.ctaDesc: Tell us the process you want to improve. You don't need to understand technical terms or prepare a feature list.
